scope: Reject unmodeled subclasses at 3D callback capture, adapter dispatch, and direct surface/modeler DXF serialization so base writers cannot silently drop additional runtime state.

captureAdmission.MESH/SPLINE/HELIX: Require the exact runtime class and corresponding public tag before retaining a built-in copy.
captureAdmission.SURFACE: Require the exact concrete surface subtype selected by eType before retaining a built-in copy.
captureAdmission.3DSOLID/REGION/BODY: Require exact DRW_ModelerGeometry and one of the three supported public tags before retaining a built-in copy.

writerAdmission.adapter: Require exact concrete surface classes and exact DRW_ModelerGeometry before dispatch.
writerAdmission.lowLevelSurface: Require exact concrete surface subtype; preserve the historical exact DRW_Surface base representation for PLANESURFACE.
writerAdmission.lowLevelModeler: Require exact DRW_ModelerGeometry and a supported modeler entity tag.

implementation.failureBehavior: Derived objects with matching public tags are refused before typed copying or serialization.
implementation.retryBehavior: After correcting the callback input or replacing the live entity with the exact built-in class, the same adapter/writer can proceed.

validationProfile.source: Locally authored C++ subclasses with an extra unmodeled field; all exact retry records are constructed in memory. No drawing fixture is used.
assertions: Typed callbacks reject and then accept exact retries for MESH, SPLINE, HELIX, PLANESURFACE, and 3DSOLID.
Adapter and direct low-level MESH/HELIX controls preserve destination bytes on subclass refusal and read back exact retry geometry/payload.
Direct low-level plane-surface and modeler controls preserve destination bytes on subclass refusal and read back exact built-in retry records.

validation.focusedTestResult: PASS: 1/1; 0.64 seconds, covering ASCII and Binary DXF refusal/retry/readback cases.
validation.fixturePolicy: No DWG/DXF fixture was added or committed.

limitations: Direct serialization retry/readback is exercised for the plane-surface and modeler families; other concrete surface subtype branches are protected by exact checks but are not each exercised by this selector.
No ACIS/SAB syntax, body association, physical producer breadth, geometric topology, kernel meaning, native consumer, whole-document closure, or support claim is qualified.
